snippet.title: Malignus - Demo Launch Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
Malignus is a 2D dungeon colony sim and emergent story generator. Play as a boss monster and their underling minions and creatures, expanding your underground dominion, building traps, and defending your prisoners and treasures from invading adventurers.

#malignus #indiegame #rimworld #dungeonkeeper #steamgame #colonysim 


AVAILABLE ON STEAM
